title: WRPGuard scope declaration (wrpguard.scope/1)
description: A caller-supplied, unverified declaration of what a relying party may request for one service and intended use. WRPGuard's own closed schema, informed by EUDI TS5; not an official EUDI format. The WRPGuard parser additionally enforces rules JSON Schema cannot express: one entry per format + type, integral numbers written as integers (1, not 1.0 or 1e0), no duplicate JSON keys, and configurable resource limits (ADR-003).

serviceId.description: Must equal the serviceId the caller evaluates for.

intendedUseId.description: Must equal the intendedUseId the caller evaluates for.

snapshot.description: Informational only; never evaluated and not evidence of provenance or freshness.

type.description: The SD-JWT VC vct or the mdoc doctype, compared by exact string equality.

claims.description: Declared OpenID4VP claims path pointers, matched exactly and element by element.

claimsPath.description: OpenID4VP 1.0 section 7 claims path pointer. Empty claim names are rejected by WRPGuard policy (WRPG-SYN-02).

mdocPath.description: OpenID4VP 1.0 section 7.2: exactly a namespace and a data element identifier.
